git_workflow.merge_procedure: Automated PR created upon 100% test pass -> Squash merge into main

features.user_story: As a User, I want a reliable environment and persistent storage so that my ebook projects are never lost and the system is always ready to work.
components: Docker Compose (FastAPI, Redis, Postgres, MinIO, Ollama)

technical_properties.resilience: Multi-table schema for chapter-level state recovery

user_acceptance_criteria: System starts all 5 services with a single docker-compose command.
Database successfully tracks chapter-level progress for parallel generations.
Files are simultaneously available in local MinIO and remote Google Drive folders.
Automatic fallback to MinIO occurs if Google Drive API is unavailable.

vibe_coding_lifecycle.git_commit_action: git checkout -b feature/track-a-foundation && git add . && git commit -m 'feat(track-a): implement core infra and dual storage' && git push origin feature/track-a-foundation

features.user_story: As a Content Creator, I want to provide a single topic and have the system orchestrate a team of AI agents to research, write, and format an ebook for me without any manual intervention.

technical_properties.concurrency: Parallel Research and Chapter Generation swarms
technical_properties.transparency: Real-time WebSocket progress and per-chapter internal logs

user_acceptance_criteria: User can login and receive a valid JWT token.
A single /api/generations call triggers the 10-15 minute 13-agent pipeline.
Parallel agents do not deadlock or compete for DB locks.
Fact-verification agent achieves 95%+ accuracy across 7-pass validation.

vibe_coding_lifecycle.setup_cmd: pip install -r requirements.txt && celery -A worker worker --loglevel=info
vibe_coding_lifecycle.git_commit_action: git checkout -b feature/track-b-orchestration && git add . && git commit -m 'feat(track-b): implement 13-agent orchestrator and JWT auth' && git push origin feature/track-b-orchestration

features.user_story: As a User, I want a modern, high-contrast, and responsive interface so that I can easily monitor my ebook generation progress and manage my assets with a premium experience.

technical_properties.aesthetic: High-contrast, bold borders (4-8px), hard shadows (no blur)
technical_properties.accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant, full keyboard navigation (CMD+G, etc.)
technical_properties.responsiveness: Optimized for mobile viewing and ultra-wide monitoring

user_acceptance_criteria: The interface strictly adheres to Neo-Brutalist design tokens (Black #000, Neo-Yellow, Neo-Pink).
The Agent Log Terminal auto-scrolls with real-time JSON log streams.
Fact-Check tiles distinctively show 'Verified' vs 'Warning' states with confidence scores.
Navigation is fully operable via keyboard shortcuts without a mouse.

vibe_coding_lifecycle.test_cmd: npm run test:visual && npm run test:accessibility
vibe_coding_lifecycle.git_commit_action: git checkout -b feature/track-c-ui && git add . && git commit -m 'feat(track-c): implement neo-brutalist design system' && git push origin feature/track-c-ui

features.user_story: As an Administrator, I want a bird's-eye view of all active and past generations so that I can oversee system health, statistics, and individual task performance.

technical_properties.visualization: Cards automatically transition across columns based on WebSocket events
technical_properties.reporting: Heatmap of generation volume and agent speed benchmarks

user_acceptance_criteria: Kanban cards move in real-time as agents progress through stages (Queued -> Analysis -> Drafting -> Publishing).
Calendar view correctly aggregates historical entries for audit and reporting.
Filters successfully narrow results by language, quality score, and content depth (1-level/2-level).

vibe_coding_lifecycle.git_commit_action: git checkout -b feature/track-d-modules && git add . && git commit -m 'feat(track-d): implement kanban board and calendar' && git push origin feature/track-d-modules

features.user_story: As a Developer, I want a zero-manual-intervention testing suite so that I can confidently deploy updates and ensure the system maintains 100% reliability.

technical_properties.coverage: Includes visual regression, functional, and performance benchmarks

user_acceptance_criteria: The full test suite completes in < 5 minutes for core services.
Any breaking change in the orchestration logic triggers an immediate pipeline halt.
Performance metrics (Topic Analysis < 30s) are automatically enforced.

vibe_coding_lifecycle.git_commit_action: git checkout -b feature/track-e-qa && git add . && git commit -m 'feat(track-e): implement automated QA suite' && git push origin feature/track-e-qa
